en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a broad, almost empty square flanked by early 20th‑century multi‑storey townhouses on the right and older, low plastered buildings with steep tiled roofs and chimneys on the left, possibly part of an industrial complex or brewery. Ornate cast‑iron street lamps line the square. In the distance a freestanding building with commercial signage on its facade faces the open space. The overall style is central European and pre‑war.
